title: AgentTrust: issue and revoke an on-chain agent credential
summary: Issue a credential PDA for an agent, fetch it while it is valid, then revoke it and see AlreadyRevoked.
what: AgentTrust is an Anchor 1.1 program for a simple on-chain credential registry aimed at AI agents. An issuer writes a credential PDA seeded by the agent pubkey and a type string, can log it with get_credential, and can revoke it. The hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment; the IDL was hand-derived from source and confirmed by live transactions.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agenttrust/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agenttrust/, switch to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare.
try_steps.see: The page lists issue_credential, get_credential and revoke_credential, and shows program 2XxFdCMo…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: issue_credential type campus-scout is already taken for the lab wallet as agent. Fetch credential 9QXpx6HL… (seeds ["credential", agent, type]).
try_steps.see: revoked=true after the lab revoke. get_credential or a second revoke should fail with AlreadyRevoked.

diagram: issuer --issue_credential--> credential PDA ["credential", agent, type] ; issuer --revoke_credential--> same PDA (revoked=true)
innovation: A minimal on-chain credential that an agent can present and an issuer can revoke.
exercises: Fetch the lab credential and confirm revoked=true.
Explain why a 33-byte type fails before the program error.
not_covered: UnauthorizedRevoke was not exercised (needs a second wallet).
build: Anchor 1.1.2 program, declared at 2XxFdCMo3fKPHKLgvbyatMoWBteCcELkv9SDC2VYqBAe on devnet. IDL hand-derived and tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Issue or inspect an on-chain agent credential and explain what revoke changes in account state.

learning_loop.objective: Predict the effect of revoke on a credential account — then inspect before/after state.
learning_loop.predict_question: An issuer revokes an existing agent credential. What should observers treat as true afterward?

predict_options.label: The credential account always disappears; absence is the only signal
Credential state shows revoked (or equivalent); verifiers must not treat it as valid
Revoke is UI-only; on-chain credential remains fully valid

learning_loop.predict_why: AgentTrust models credentials as on-chain records an issuer can revoke. Verifiers must read credential state — not assume “account still exists ⇒ valid.”
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/agenttrust/ on Devnet. Issue a practice credential or inspect a recorded issue+revoke pair. Compare credential fields before and after revoke.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must a verifier read revoke state instead of trusting that the credential account still exists?
learning_loop.transfer: Write one verifier checklist item that would reject a revoked credential.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for AgentTrust elective: issue/revoke semantics.

criteria.title: Identifies credential account
criteria.question: Can the student point to the credential record used for verification?
criteria.not_yet: Confuses issuer wallet with credential state.
criteria.independent: Records credential address and relevant fields.
criteria.misconception: Issuer signature alone is the credential.

criteria.title: Explains revoke effect
criteria.question: Can the student state what changes when revoke succeeds?
criteria.not_yet: Says revoke deletes everything or changes nothing.
criteria.independent: Describes revoked status (or equivalent) and verifier impact.

criteria.title: Issuer authority awareness
criteria.question: Does the student know who may revoke?
criteria.independent: States issuer (or designated authority) constraint from evidence.
criteria.misconception: Subject can always self-revoke without program rules.

criteria.title: Evidence honesty
criteria.question: Are platform proofs labelled separately from the student’s attempt?
criteria.misconception: Any Explorer link completes the elective.
